title: M006f immutable shadow session package
hypothesis: Accepted-event evidence, exact market evidence, replay output and shadow simulation results can be bound into one deterministic immutable session package without adding network, submission, promotion or capital authority.
result: PASS: all five component SHA-256 digests and the independently recomputed aggregate package-content hash matched. The packaged synthetic session contained 2 replay events, 0 suppressed chains, ended flat, and preserved network/submission/automatic-promotion capability as false.
